teams.title: Teams
teams.name: Name
teams.rule: Only characters with at least one hit between Intro and Outro in the Rotation build can join a team. A starts the rotation without Intro.
teams.rotationInfo: Order A → B → C. A starts the first rotation without Intro; in the second one, A does the Intro after C. Each member keeps its own copy of the hits here: changes in the team do not change the character. Damage uses the current attributes, levels, Echos and mode of each character, without buffs yet.
